title: X-LAB DAWNBREAKER frameset specification
notes: Official mainland frameset page: frame weight 1,245 g in size S excluding fork, seatpost and handlebar; the package lists the X-LAB TT carbon fork, X-LAB TT carbon base bar, Vision Metron TFE PRO extensions and 350 mm X-LAB TT carbon seatpost. The official bicycle listing shows the frameset at CNY 49,980.
